name: No-probe control for the B3 readiness task
reason: Reviewer item R4: the task success of Eq. (2) measures the reporter rise within 20 min after the probe relative to the sending time; a rebound after the previous command could produce part of that rise without any probe.
simulation: For every posterior sample and both previous commands (3 and 30 min at 25 ng/ml), the noise-free reporter without a probe on a 1-min grid from 0 to 140 min, and for every wait in {0, 2, ..., 120} min the reporter with the 5-min probe on a 1-min grid over [wait, wait + 20]. Same model, tolerances and parameter samples as version 2.

quantities.rise_without_probe: max over [wait, wait + 20] of the no-probe reporter minus its value at the wait
quantities.probe_increment: max over [wait, wait + 20] of (probe reporter - no-probe reporter)
quantities.success_without_probe: rise_without_probe >= 0.5 x the same sample's naive rise
quantities.causal_success: probe_increment >= 0.5 x the same sample's naive rise

reports: fraction of (sample, history, wait) states meeting the original criterion without any probe, overall, per history and per wait
agreement between the original success and the causal success
version-3 decisions on the primary split at noise 0.005 (unchanged rules, calibrated with the original labels) rescored with the causal labels
unchanged: The original task definition remains the primary analysis; this is a diagnostic.
reporting: All quantities reported whatever their direction; simulation of one published model structure.
